How to adopt from Monroe Humane

  1. Step 1: Submit an interest application online using our quick application form.
  2. Step 2: Shelter Meet & Greet at 911 S. Raisinville Rd during public hours (Tue–Fri 11am–4pm, Sat 11am–3pm).
  3. Step 3: Take your new family member home with complete medical records, vaccinations, and microchip.
